title: Multifractal Analysis, Livšic Rigidity, and Fluctuation Theorems for Axiom A Diffeomorphisms: The Pesin Formula and the Gallavotti-Cohen Symmetry
summary: This Part develops structural consequences of the thermodynamic formalism for Axiom A diffeomorphisms. The Pesin Entropy Formula equates the metric entropy of the SRB measure to the sum of positive Lyapunov exponents, with complete proofs of absolute continuity of conditional measures along unstable manifolds; the individual results are due to Sinai, Ruelle, Bowen, and Pesin. The Multifractal Formalism computes the Hausdorff dimension of Birkhoff average level sets via the Legendre transform of the pressure, extending earlier work of Barreira, Pesin, and Schmeling.
